name: @a3s-lab/code
description: A3S Code - Native Node.js bindings for the coding-agent runtime

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --js index.js --dts generated.d.ts && node scripts/patch-loader.mjs
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --js index.js --dts generated.d.ts && node scripts/patch-loader.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:release-manifest && npm run test:evaluation-protocol && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:fixtures
scripts.test:runtime: node test.mjs && node test_budget_guard.mjs && node test_callback_safety.mjs && node test_confirmation_inheritance.mjs && node test_session_close.mjs && node test_workspace_retrieval.mjs && node test_serve.mjs && node test-helpers.mjs
